outcome.technical: _evidence_io.reusable_run now selects the newest VERDICT row for the identity (candidates filtered by identity/scope/subject/not-a-repeat/repeatable word) and returns None when that newest row is mute-excused, instead of stepping over it to an older red. New helper newer_for_identity. run-test-gate.py: reused_result takes newer, render_reuse prints a 'repeats:' line naming the row and a 'newer row:' line saying why a newer row for the identity was not taken (it is itself a repeat). reference/execute-task.md documents it.
